indication_area: Paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria; C3 glomerulopathy and primary IC-MPGN from 2025

approval_evidence.quote: This new drug application provides for the use of Empaveli (pegcetacoplan) injection for the treatment of adult patients with paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria (PNH).

series_start_reason: Q1 2021 product revenue is nil (the 10-Q prints a dash); the first printed EMPAVELI sales are in the second quarter 2021 10-Q, after the May 2021 approval. Series starts there.
series_end_reason: Biogen acquired Apellis through a tender offer that expired 2026-05-13 and closed on 2026-05-14 (Apellis 8-K accession 0001193125-26-222923, dated 2026-05-14). Apellis filed a Form 15-12G on 2026-05-26 and no 10-Q for 2026Q2 exists in EDGAR.
notes: Scope is EMPAVELI U.S. net product revenue. Each 10-Q and 10-K states the product revenue is derived from sales in the United States. From 2025 the product line includes C3G and IC-MPGN sales after the July 2025 approval for those indications, in the same U.S. line. Ex-U.S. systemic pegcetacoplan (Aspaveli) is partnered to Sobi and is not in this line; Sobi royalties are reported separately by Apellis and are not used. Q4 figures derived from the full-year line less nine months.
search_log: Bigdata search for EMPAVELI net product revenue by quarter; results confirmed the U.S. product revenue and the Sobi ex-U.S. arrangement.

Listed every 10-Q and 10-K for CIK 1492422 via data.sec.gov submissions; fetched each primary document and read the EMPAVELI row (2021 and 2022 filings print the total product revenue line, which was EMPAVELI only before SYFOVRE was approved in February 2023).
Fourth quarters derived as full-year 10-K less nine months from the Q3 10-Q; the four quarters match each full-year figure.
2026Q2 not sourced: the tender offer closed 2026-05-14 (8-K) and no later 10-Q exists; series ends 2026Q1.
